queueing_delay_ms.label: IPC + queue wake-up overhead, NOT 'pure IPC' -- see decomposition below

pickle_roundtrip_only_ms.label: in-process pickle.dumps+loads of one Task object, no queue/pipe/second-process involved -- a lower bound on the serialization component alone

method: single worker, requests sent one-at-a-time with a gap exceeding service time so genuine queueing wait is ~0. queueing_delay_ms (enqueue_ts to execution_start) bundles pickling + pipe transfer + OS wake-up scheduling latency for the blocked worker + unpickling -- these are not separable from that single number alone. pickle_roundtrip_only_ms isolates just the serialization component via an in-process microbenchmark on an identical Task object, as a partial decomposition.
